one_liner: Web data API to search, scrape, map, and crawl the live web at scale.
auth_notes: API key passed via Bearer token in the Authorization header or specific SDK options.
access_notes: New accounts start on a free plan offering 1,000 credits/month with no credit card required.
api_notes: Endpoints cover scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, batch scrape, interact and monitor under base URL api.firecrawl.dev.
blocker_notes: Public API, self-serve free tier, official MCP, and SDKs readily available.

auth.quote:
Authorization
Bearer authentication header of the form
Bearer <token>
<token>
is your auth token.

access.quote: New accounts start on the free plan. It costs nothing and does not need a card.

api.quote: Scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, batch scrape, interact and monitor all work on the free plan.

mcp.quote: Yes. Firecrawl has an official MCP server so agents in Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, and other MCP-compatible tools can search, scrape, and interact with the web directly.

verdict.quote: Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required.
